mechanism.claim: When average outstanding BTC perpetual open-interest value is unusually large relative to completed quote turnover, the market carries a large leveraged inventory through limited transaction capacity. During elevated realized variation, a new upper-tail inventory/turnover scarcity state should propagate the completed displacement for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed eight-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: GOICR and HVOIPCSR use changes in OI; price-impact candidates divide displacement by turnover but ignore outstanding inventory. HVOTSC uses the level ratio mean(sum_open_interest_value)/sum(quote_asset_volume), no OI change, flow direction, tickets, premium, funding, or prior event/control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three daily inventory-capacity onset opportunities are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.oi_path: 96 exact unique positive BTCUSDT open_interest_binance period=5m observations D-8h through D-5m, each observed_at<=D
features.quote_turnover: sum quote_asset_volume over 480 rows, finite strict positive
features.average_oi_value: arithmetic mean sum_open_interest_value over 96 observations, finite strict positive
features.scarcity_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.realized_variation: sum squared log(close/open) over 480 one-minute rows, finite strict positive
features.completed_return: log(last close/first open), finite strict nonzero
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.decision: D after all source rows complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no window, ratio, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
